name: Uplifter Glassworker GW600 PRO
summary: Radio-controlled hydraulic glazing robot with front drive, automatic angle correction and a removable vacuum cross (UPG600) that can also be used on its own, lifting glass of up to 600 kg to 3.6 m vertical mounting height. Made by Uplifter in Bavaria.

germany.statusNote: Sold and rented by the German maker Uplifter (Guteneck, Bavaria) through a purchase request form on the product page; the shop shows no price ("€0.00"). Delivered with operating instructions and CE declaration of conformity.

sellers.name: Uplifter Service GmbH
sellers.note: 92543 Guteneck, Germany. A purchase request form on the product page; e-mail addresses on the contact page are hidden behind spam protection.

specs.label: Load by suction cups
specs.value: 4 cups 300 kg, 6 cups 450 kg, 8 cups 600 kg
specs.quote: Load capacity: 4 suction cups = 300 kg, 6 suction cups = 450 kg and 8 suction cups = 600 kg

specs.label: Total weight with vacuum cup
specs.quote: Total weight of glassworker + vacuum suction cup approx. 1,035 - 1,095 kg

specs.label: Control
specs.value: radio remote control with LCD display
specs.quote: Sensitive radio remote control with LCD display, charger, second battery and accessories

specs.label: Vacuum standard
specs.quote: Meets the requirements of DIN EN 13155

notes: Technical data say "Off-road: Yes" (roughGround is a maker claim).
Hydraulic side shift (±50 mm), turning and swivel in the vacuum cross; automatic angle correction.
The UPG600 vacuum cross can be removed and used on its own, e.g. on a crane.
Operator-controlled by radio remote; not autonomous.
